task_description: Computes the square root of a nonnegative real number and proves the monotonicity of the squaring operation over positive reals through a lemma. The `sqrt` method ensures it returns a nonnegative root satisfying the square-equals-input property, while the `monotonicSquare` lemma uses multiplicative monotonicity to prove that the square function preserves order relations within the positive number domain.

test_cases.test_1:
var res1:=sqrt(0.0);
assert res1 * res1 == 0.0 && res1 >= 0.0;
test_cases.test_2:
var res2:=sqrt(1.0);
assert res2 * res2 == 1.0 && res2 >= 0.0;
test_cases.test_3:
var res3:=sqrt(9.0);
assert res3 * res3 == 9.0 && res3 >= 0.0;
